tagline.zh: 照片和插画一键变成 Brio 姿势
tagline.en: Turn photos and illustrations into Brio poses

title.zh: 面部表情、灯光、构图截图与更快的识别
title.en: Facial expressions, lighting, framing & screenshots, faster recognition

zh: 后端更新会自动补齐新功能要的组件（面捕约 64 MB、深度图约 400 MB）：老一键包在设置页点一次「更新后端」就行，不用重新下载整个一键包。下载慢可以填下载加速前缀，断了重试时已下好的组件不用重下
面部表情（测试）：照片里的表情换算成游戏的脸部骨骼——闭眼、眯眼、挑眉、嘴角、张嘴、歪嘴、视线都按照片的实际幅度还原，最多到游戏里这块脸能动的极限。第一次用要在游戏里输入 /posegraph facedump 导出一次游戏表情数据（一两分钟）
分项权重：眼睑、眉毛、嘴部、下巴、视线可以分开调，哪一块不像就单独调哪一块（调整页「面部表情」里，默认展开）
头部朝向跟脸：用面捕修正头的朝向，低头、侧脸的角度更准（默认一半，调整页「面部表情」里的「头部跟脸」滑条，不开表情也生效）
Brio 改动收进图库：应用姿势后在 Brio 里手动改了骨骼，主窗口会提示「检测到在 Brio 里改了 N 根骨骼」，点「收进修正并存进图库」就变成这张图的修正，下次打开自动套上，改别的调整值重新应用时也不会被冲掉
灯光：工具栏灯泡按钮，一键给当前角色打光（11 套方案），灯跟着脸和镜头摆；独立的 3D 灯光视图里可以拖动、旋转每盏灯，单独看某一盏或关掉某一盏
构图与截图：构图框（横竖构图、遮暗框外、三分线等参考线）、等效全画幅焦距、按原图比例一键适配，可叠加原图做参考；一键截图直接存进 Posegraph
复刻镜头更稳：按帧等镜头稳定，低帧率时不再偶尔复刻歪；宽幅照片的视场角更准
深度图（MoGe-2）：识别时顺带估计镜头焦距和地面，人物站位、镜头复刻更准；设置页「深度辅助识别」可以关掉（关掉更快、更省显存）
识别更快：移植 Fast SAM 3D Body，单人识别约快一倍（GPU 约 0.6 秒，设置页「快速识别」）
3D 页：骨骼旋转环（像 Brio 一样选轴直接拖）；右键 / 中键拖动平移视图
调整页新增「整体旋转 / 位移」：整个人歪了、要抬高放低时用
并行识别（实验）：批量识别时按显存余量开几路同时识别，失败自动退回逐张
修复：图库图片多时缩略图可能把游戏冲崩；连本机后端不再走系统代理；后端解码不了的图片改用 Windows 解码重试；3D 页底部勾选框被切掉一截、英文界面下拉框文字被截断
合并模式（一张图多人）还在打磨，这一版先关着，下个版本开放
en: Backend updates now add the components new features need (face capture about 64 MB, depth about 400 MB): older one-click packages just click "Update backend" once on Settings, no need to download the whole package again. Set a download prefix if it's slow; finished components aren't downloaded again when you retry

Facial expressions (beta): the photo's expression is turned into the game's face bones. Eyes closing or squinting, brows, mouth corners, open or crooked mouths and gaze follow the photo's actual amount, up to what each part of the face can move in game. The first time, type /posegraph facedump in game to export the game's expression data once (a minute or two)
Per-part weights: eyelids, brows, mouth, jaw and gaze can be tuned separately, so you only adjust the part that looks off (under Facial expressions on the Tuning tab, expanded by default)

Head follows face: face capture corrects the head direction, so tilted and turned heads are more accurate (half by default; the "Head follows face" slider under Facial expressions, works even with expressions off)

Keep Brio edits in the library: if you change bones in Brio after applying, the main window says how many bones you changed; "Keep as correction and save to library" stores them with the image, so they come back next time and re-applying after other tweaks no longer wipes them

Lighting: the light bulb on the toolbar lights the current character in one click (11 setups) and keeps the lights placed relative to the face and camera; a separate 3D lighting view lets you drag and rotate each light, solo it or mute it

Framing & screenshots: a framing box (landscape or portrait, dim outside, thirds and other guides), equivalent full-frame focal length, one-click fit to the photo's aspect, an optional photo overlay for reference, and one-click screenshots saved into Posegraph
Steadier camera matching: waits for the camera by frames, so low frame rates no longer occasionally match it crooked; wide photos get a more accurate field of view

Depth (MoGe-2): recognition also estimates the camera focal length and the floor, making placement and camera matching more accurate; turn off "Depth-assisted recognition" on Settings for speed and less VRAM
Faster recognition: ported from Fast SAM 3D Body, single-person recognition is about twice as fast (about 0.6 s on GPU, "Fast recognition" on Settings)
3D tab: rotation rings on bones (pick an axis and drag, like Brio); pan the view with the right or middle mouse button
Tuning tab: new "Whole-body rotation / offset" for when the whole person leans or needs raising or lowering
Parallel recognition (experimental): batch recognition runs several at once based on free VRAM and falls back to one by one on failure

Fixes: library thumbnails could crash the game with many images; the local backend no longer goes through the system proxy; images the backend can't decode are retried via Windows; the 3D tab's bottom checkbox was cut off and dropdown text was truncated in English
Merge mode (several people in one image) is still being polished and stays off in this version; it opens in the next one

title.zh: 拆分模式、辅助视角与新界面
title.en: Split mode, extra views and a new look

zh: 角色列表（拆分模式）：GPose 里的多个角色各绑一张图，一键全部应用；某个角色要细调时点「编辑」切到主窗口
辅助视角：给一张图挂上同一动作其他角度的图（最好是约 90° 的侧面），自动融合修正单张图猜不准的前后深度；主图里看到的姿势不会被改动
辅助视角在图库右键菜单里管理（从文件、剪切板添加，或把选中的图挂上来），不占用图库网格；文件名为「主图名-1」的图导入时自动挂上
批量识别只加载一次模型：主图连同辅助视角、全部应用、批量队列都更快（模型设置为“识别后立即释放”时尤其明显）
全新的界面主题与排版：深灰底、青蓝强调色；工具栏分三行，默认窗口大小下不再裁切
新增更新日志窗口（就是这个），在设置页可以随时再打开
调整页的数值（幅度、手部补偿、站姿、辅助骨）随「保存修正」存进每张图；新图片都从默认值开始，不再沿用上一张图调过的值。调整页顶部也有保存按钮，有未保存的修改时会提示
窗口变窄或英文界面下，放不下的文字以「…」结尾、悬停显示全文；底部状态按宽度换行
en: Character list (split mode): bind one image to each GPose character and apply them all at once; click Edit to fine-tune one in the main window

Extra views: attach images of the same pose from other angles (a ~90° side view is best). They are fused automatically to fix the front/back depth a single image can't tell, without changing the pose you see in the main image

Manage extra views from the library's right-click menu (add from files or the clipboard, or attach selected images); they don't clutter the library grid. Images named "main-1" are attached automatically on import
Batch recognition loads the model only once: main image plus extra views, Apply all and the batch queue are all faster (most noticeable with "release after recognition")
New theme and layout: dark gray with a teal accent; the toolbar now uses three rows and no longer gets cut off at the default window size
New changelog window (this one); reopen it any time from Settings

Tuning values (amplitude, hand compensation, stance, helper bones) are saved with each image via "Save correction"; new images start from the defaults instead of the last image's values. The Tuning tab now has the save button too and shows when there are unsaved changes
Text that doesn't fit in a narrow window or in English ends with "…" and shows in full on hover; the status line wraps

zh: 图库窗口：导入（多选、文件夹、拖放、剪切板）、文件夹 / 标签 / 收藏分类、重命名、移动、删除到回收站
识别结果按图片内容缓存，再次打开不用重新识别；批量识别队列
3D 页「保存修正」：手动偏移和调整参数跟着图片走，打开时自动恢复
存到 Brio 姿势库（带预览图和标签）
女性骨架适配；膝、肘、肩辅助骨规则按游戏内采样更新
拖到主窗口的图不再自动存入图库，识别后由你决定是否存入（按内容查重，附带 3D 修正）
导入、剪切板读取的思路来自 uiharuayako 的 PR
en: Library window: import (multi-select, folders, drag & drop, clipboard), organize with folders, tags and favorites, rename, move, delete to the Recycle Bin
Recognition results are cached by image content, so reopening an image doesn't rerun the model; batch recognition queue
"Save correction" on the 3D tab: manual offsets and tuning travel with the image and are restored when it is opened
Save to the Brio pose library (with preview and tags)
Female skeleton support; knee, elbow and shoulder helper bone rules updated from in-game sampling
Images dropped on the main window are no longer added to the library automatically; you choose after recognition (deduplicated by content, with 3D corrections)
Import and clipboard ideas from uiharuayako's PR

zh: 切换角色不再重置该角色在 Brio 里的姿势，每个角色的状态单独记住
角色列表只列人形角色，过滤宠物、坐骑等
检测 IVCS：没加载时把手指第三节的弯曲折算到第二节，状态栏显示 IVCS 图标
修复多次换种族后骨长错乱
许可证改为 MIT
en: Switching characters no longer resets their Brio pose; each character's state is remembered separately
The character list only shows humanoid characters (no pets, mounts, etc.)
IVCS detection: without IVCS, the third finger joint's bend is folded into the second; IVCS icon in the status bar
Fixed bone lengths going wrong after changing race several times
License changed to MIT

zh: GPose 里始终显示界面；进入 GPose 时自动打开的界面在退出时自动关闭
换种族后自动重新读取参考姿势并重新应用
调整值按预设自动保存
加入插件图标
en: The UI always shows in GPose; a window opened automatically on entering GPose closes when you leave
After a race change the reference pose is reread and reapplied automatically
Tuning values are saved per preset
Plugin icon

zh: 一键包用户可以在设置页直接更新后端
en: Backend package users can update the backend from Settings

zh: 从照片或插画识别人物姿势，经 Brio 应用到 GPose 角色
支持全部可玩种族、复刻照片镜头、调整滑杆、导出 .pose
低显存 / CPU 模式
en: Recognize the pose in a photo or illustration and apply it to your GPose character through Brio
All playable races, camera matching, tuning sliders, .pose export
Low-VRAM / CPU mode
